steps.description:
Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create an empty list named numberList

2. Insert 1 to the last position of numberList for 5 times

3. Display numberList on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds

Show that your robot can perform the following:

1. Generate and display a random number from 1-5 for 2 second

2. Create an empty list named numberList

3. Repeat the following a number of times equal to the random number (e.g. repeat 5 times if the random number is 5):

    a. Add 1 to the last position of numberList

4. Display numberList on the LCD for 2 seconds

The program can only be terminated when the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked

Show that your robot can perform the following

1. Create an empty list named numberList

2. When Button A is pressed, 

    a. Add 1 to numberList

    b. Display the length of numberList in the following format for 1 second:

        "The length is #" where # is the number of 1s in numberList


Example:

      If you pressed Button A for the fifth time, "The length is 5" will be displayed

The program can only be terminated when the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked


Show that your robot can perform the following

1. Create an empty list named numberList

2. When Button A is pressed, add 1 to numberList and display "1 is added" on the LCD for 1 second

3. When Button B is pressed, display the length of numberList in the following format for 1 second:

    "The length is #" where # is the number of 1s in numberList


    Example

    If you pressed Button A five times, you have appended five 1s into numberList

    If you then press Buttons B, "The length is 5" will be displayed

The program can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked

Show that your robot can perform the following
1. Create an empty list named numberList

2. When Button A is pressed, add 1 to numberList and display "1 is added" on the LCD for 1 second

3. When Button B is pressed, 

    a. When the length of the numberList is more than 0, 

        remove the last value from numberList and display "1 is removed" on the LCD for 1 second

    b. When the length of the numberList is 0, do nothing

4. When Button A and B are pressed, display the length of numberList in the following format for 1 second:

    "The length is #" where # is the number of 1s in numberList

Example

     If you pressed Button A five times, you have appended five 1s into numberList

     If you pressed Button B once, you have removed one 1 from numberList

     If you then press Buttons A and B, "The length is 4" will be displayed

The program can only be terminated when the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked

Show that your robot can perform the following:

1. Create an empty list named numberList

2. When Button A is pressed,

    a. When the length of numberList is less than 5, 

        append 1 to numberList and display "1 is added" on the LCD for 1 second

    b. When the length of the number list is 5 or more, 

        display "List is full" on the LCD for 1 second

3. When Button B is pressed, 

    a. When the length of the numberList is more than 0, 

        remove the last value from numberList and display "1 is removed" on the LCD for 1 second

    b. When the length of the numberList is 0, display "List is empty" on the LCD for 1 second

4. When Button A and B are pressed, display the length of numberList in the following format for 1 second:

    "The length is #" where # is the number of 1s in numberList


     Example

     If you pressed Button A five times, you have appended five 1s into numberList

     If you pressed Button B once, you have removed one 1 from numberList

     If you then press Buttons A and B, "The length is 4" will be displayed

Show that your robot can perform the following

2. When Button A is pressed
- Insert 1 to the last position of numberList
- Display "1 is added" on the LCD Screen for 1 second

3. When Button B is pressed, display the length of the number List with the following format:
- The length is #

Example 1
If you pressed Button A twice, you have appended two 1 into numberList
LCD will display "The length is 2"

Example 2
If you pressed Button A five times, you have appended two 1 into numberList
LCD will display "The length is 5"

The program can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked
